author: EyMoose
body:
Hello Again Avicus,

This appeal, being done at Imzkoolerz's house because I stay there during the weekend, is really not for me, but for Kool. 

I was banned for Kill Aura and AKB, which will remain valid. I do not care that I remain banned. Kool has stopped talking to me and seems really depressed to be kept from his friends in Walls on mc zone, and he really wants to get back on. I made the mistake and I should be punished, not him. You might tell me that it is my fault, I was hacking so I would take him down with me, because I used his wifi for two months when exploring the colleges here and broken back. I know you guys believe in second chances for people. If there needs to be more time to discuss this, I am ok with it, but it really is not right to not let him meet his good friends on Avicus. Kool is already depressed and has a almost cured form of cancer. He is bullied in school and avicus was the place for him to empty out his feelings. I know you guys must be thinking that this is made up and you need evidence, but it really really would help him if you let him back on. Avicus for me has been a rocky journey ending up with me, in rage because of something that had priorly happened, coming on to the server and wanting to kill people. My fatal mistake that punished many people. Got kools sister banned too. 

If there needs to be a temp ban or waiting period, pls shorten for both of them. I am selling my account so I really wont be on avicus anymore, need to get in to studies more as my back heals. Avicus was a fun experience and made me many friends, but I was very stupid. Thanks for everything, this will probably be my final word. 

Thanks
Hax

replies.body:
I am heading back to my college dorms today, and want to know if anything will be done? I sold my account to someone in Reading, MA and will not be returning to minecraft. Kool still wants to play nebula and he had joined over 2 or 3 years ago for this sole purpose. 
Maybe you will unban him and maybe not.
Good bye friends and foes
Farewell Avicus.
Hax

Hello,

You wrote a massive paragraph explaining your ban, but there is no evidence, just a bunch of statements.

You won't be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
